title: why use affiliate automations
text:
Affiliate automations let you use HighLevel Workflows to manage common Affiliate Manager tasks automatically. You can create affiliates, add or remove them from campaigns, assign leads, respond to affiliate-attributed sales, update affiliate status, and automate onboarding or internal notifications.

Benefits of Using Affiliate Automations
Time-Saving Efficiency: Automations handle repetitive tasks such as affiliate onboarding, lead assignment, and commission tracking, freeing up your time for more valuable work.
Improved Accuracy: Manual errors in commission calculations or lead assignments are reduced by automating these processes, ensuring accuracy and transparency.
Better Affiliate Engagement: Automatically notify affiliates about important milestones, payments, and successes, keeping them engaged and motivated.
Scalability: As your affiliate program grows, automations allow you to manage a larger number of affiliates without a significant increase in manual tasks.
Customizable Workflows: Create workflows tailored to your unique business needs, ensuring that affiliate operations are streamlined for your specific goals.
Common Use Cases for Affiliate Automations
Affiliate automations offer flexibility across several key tasks. Below are some of the most common and useful automations you can implement.
1. Automate Affiliate Onboarding
Use the Affiliate Created trigger to start a workflow when a new affiliate account is created. You can then add follow-up actions for onboarding, internal notifications, or other affiliate-management tasks.

To automatically convert an existing contact into an affiliate or enroll an affiliate in a campaign, use actions such as Add to Affiliate Manager or Add to Affiliate Campaign.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003663-getting-started-with-affiliate-automations] Affiliate Created Workflow Trigger
Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign: Start a workflow when an affiliate is added to a campaign. This is useful for campaign-specific onboarding, internal notifications, and affiliate communications.

2. Assign Leads and Track Affiliate Sales
Assign Affiliate Leads

Use Lead Created to start workflows for newly created affiliate-attributed leads, or use Add Leads under an Affiliate to assign contacts to an affiliate and campaign.

Respond to Affiliate Sales
Use New Affiliate Sales to start workflows when a sale is attributed to an affiliate. You can use optional filters such as affiliate, campaign, payout-method status, and tax-form status.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003665-how-to-automate-lead-assignment-to-affiliates] Adding Leads Under an Affiliate Through Workflows
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003666-automating-affiliate-commissions-with-add-manual-sales-for-an-affiliate-workflow-action] https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003666-automating-affiliate-commissions-with-add-manual-sales-for-an-affiliate-workflow-action [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003666-automating-affiliate-commissions-with-add-manual-sales-for-an-affiliate-workflow-action] Add Manual Sales for an Affiliate
3. Manage and Track Commissions
Automatically calculate commissions based on campaign settings and track the status of affiliate payouts to ensure timely rewards.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003664-how-to-automate-affiliate-sales-with-the-new-affiliate-sales-trigger] Affiliate Sales Trigger in Workflows
4. Campaign Enrollment and Targeted Communication
Automate the enrollment of affiliates into specific campaigns and send personalized communication based on their performance and engagement.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003040-all-about-affiliate-enrolled-in-campaign-trigger] Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Trigger
5. Reward and Engage Affiliates
Send automatic notifications to affiliates when certain actions are completed, such as sales made or specific milestones achieved.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003040-all-about-affiliate-enrolled-in-campaign-trigger] Congratulatory Emails or SMS for Affiliate Engagement
Manage Affiliate Status and Campaign Membership

Workflows can automate common affiliate-management tasks:
Add to Affiliate Manager: Add a contact as an active affiliate.

Update Affiliate: Mark an affiliate as active or inactive.

Add to Affiliate Campaign: Add an affiliate to a selected campaign.

Remove from Affiliate Campaign: Remove an affiliate from a campaign.

Important: The New Affiliate Sale workflow commonly runs on the buyer’s Contact record. Standard actions such as Send Email or Send SMS may therefore contact the buyer instead of the affiliate. Use affiliate-specific communication actions when the message is intended for the affiliate.

Quick Access to Workflow Automations
To help you implement these workflows, here’s a quick overview of each automation article, providing easy access to detailed step-by-step guides:
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003663-getting-started-with-affiliate-automations] Affiliate Created Workflow Trigger: Learn how to automatically add affiliates to campaigns and keep them updated on their status.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003664-how-to-automate-affiliate-sales-with-the-new-affiliate-sales-trigger] Affiliate Sales Trigger in Workflows: Track and automate sales generated by affiliates, and set up notifications or segmentation for better tracking.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003665-how-to-automate-lead-assignment-to-affiliates] Adding Leads Under an Affiliate Through Workflows: Use Add Leads under an Affiliate to assign a contact to an affiliate and campaign. The action supports Manual, Auto-Track via Attribution, and Custom Mapping assignment methods.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003666-automating-affiliate-commissions-with-add-manual-sales-for-an-affiliate-workflow-action] Add Manual Sales for an Affiliate: Assign manual sales and calculate commissions with ease, including offline sales.
 [https://help.gohighlevel.com/en/support/solutions/articles/155000003040-all-about-affiliate-enrolled-in-campaign-trigger] Affiliate Enrolled In Campaign Trigger: Automatically track when an affiliate is added to a campaign and gather all necessary data.
Conclusion: Streamline and Scale with Affiliate Automations
Affiliate automations provide you with the tools to efficiently manage your affiliate program without the hassle of manual tracking and administrative work. By integrating these automations into your workflows, you can ensure accurate tracking, timely communication, and effective scaling of your program. Whether you are onboarding new affiliates, assigning leads, or tracking commissions, affiliate automations offer the perfect solution to optimize your operations and grow your business.

Start implementing automations today and experience the benefits of streamlined affiliate management!
